approvals_insert.name: approvals_insert
approvals_insert.withCheck: app_workspace_role("approvals"."workspace_id") in ('owner', 'admin', 'operator') and "approvals"."status" = 'pending' and "approvals"."resolved_at" is null and "approvals"."resolved_by" is null

runs_insert.name: runs_insert
runs_insert.withCheck: app_workspace_role("runs"."workspace_id") in ('owner', 'admin', 'operator') and "runs"."created_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and "runs"."totals" = '{"inputTokens":0,"outputTokens":0,"cacheReadTokens":0,"cacheWriteTokens":0,"costMicroUsd":0}'::jsonb

runs_forked_from_seq_needs_parent.name: runs_forked_from_seq_needs_parent
runs_forked_from_seq_needs_parent.value: "runs"."forked_from_seq" is null or ("runs"."parent_run_id" is not null and "runs"."forked_from_seq" >= 0)

workspaces_demo_retention_max_7_days.name: workspaces_demo_retention_max_7_days
workspaces_demo_retention_max_7_days.value: not "workspaces"."is_demo" or ("workspaces"."retention_days" is not null and "workspaces"."retention_days" <= 7)

playbooks_insert.name: playbooks_insert
playbooks_insert.withCheck: "playbooks"."workspace_id" is not null and "playbooks"."scope" = 'workspace' and app_workspace_role("playbooks"."workspace_id") in ('owner', 'admin', 'operator')
